posts.subject: Fiddles and Oxygen Admin Abuse.
posts.editReason:
New evidence added.
Fiddles is not a 'new English admin' - removed new
posts.bodyHtml:
Dear Dream Community,


I have some very interesting, yet quite disappointing information about our English admins, Fiddles and Oxygen. It was on the Sunday 19th June 2016, night time, when @KnAWLeDGE witnessed both @OxygeN and @Fiddles admin abusing.



Please watch this video and then read on:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GcHanqE5Uw8



There as you can see, at the beginning of the video, nothing much happened. However, at the beginning of the new round, it was clear that an admin toggled firebomb to every single player on the map (apart from a few people for some reason) and that most people died after it - some people abused the spawn hp-regain bug and survived the firebomb) and that actually, at the end of the video, a player asked why some people survived and Fiddles (note that at the beginning of the video, the voice that sounds like Fiddles was his brother, but at the end, you can clearly see his name and profile picture when he is talking) that "I don't know why actually, I did toggle it on everyone" which implies that Fiddles started the firebomb. This is clearly an example of admin abuse and should NOT be tolerated. [disli-ke*] [dieregeln*]


Now you may ask, what has Oxygen got to do with this? Well, considering he's part of the admin team and he was on the server, he could've easily stopped it by reactivating the firebomb (!firebomb @all) but he didn't, and actually sat there to watch and laugh at players dying for no reason. [chipsfressen*] [neinnein*]


I hope this issue will get looked into as I'm pretty sure it had a big impact on how players now view the Dream Knife Server.


//EDIT: Furthermore to unfortunately highlight Fiddle's admin abuse, here is a screenshot of what @OxygeN said about @Fiddles before the incident.
